<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'

result = number % modulus
print(f"{number} mod {modulus} = {result}")

# Let's verify this by checking our answer
quotient = number // modulus
remainder = number % modulus

# Verify: number = quotient * modulus + remainder

print(f"\nVerification:")
print(f"Quotient: {quotient}")
print(f"Remainder: {remainder}")
print(f"{quotient} × {modulus} + {remainder} = {check}")

print(f"Match: {check == number}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
